newsitem.title: UK: Cadbury bounces on talk of broker comments.
newsitem.headline: Cadbury bounces on talk of broker comments.

text.p: Shares in Cadbury Schweppes Plc rebounded on Wednesday amid talk of upbeat comments from analysts after the UK food manufacturer released its results earlier, dealers said.
By 1247 GMT, the shares were up 11-1/2p to 521-1/2, having slipped as low as 502 immediately after the results were released.
Dealers said SBC Warburg and Dresdner Kleinwort Benson repeated their "buy" ratings. The analysts weren't immediately available to comment.

Earlier, Cadbury said its pre-tax profits rose 16 percent to 592 million stg in the year ended December 28, which was at the top end of analysts' forecasts. The company added it was confident of growth in 1997 despite the strength in the pound. --London newsroom +44 171 542 5106
